name: Sherlock Holmes
beats: Sherlock Holmes: tall and lean, in his shirtsleeves for the heat, a pipe to hand; he speaks precisely and briefly.
Bored by the holiday's harmlessness until offered a diversion; then playful and competitive, and generous when beaten.
Once he has set Watson his wager, he will not hear a reading of a man Watson has not yet looked at: he tells him to look first.
